title: Optimal and minimal $p$-ary linear codes from generalized order ideals of hierarchical posets
summary: Hyun, Kim, Wu and Yue constructed optimal and minimal binary linear codes from order ideals of hierarchical posets with two levels. Two different generalizations of the underlying antichain (simplicial complex) setting to odd characteristic are known: down-sets of $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ under the componentwise order, and support-closed subsets of $\mathbb{F}_q^m$. No generalization of the poset setting itself has appeared.
